text:
Sam (CEO): quick weekly — three items + short metrics snapshot. please read and reaction if blocking.
Sam (CEO): 1) Policy: hosted API default data retention will become 90 days. Priya + Legal to finalize customer messaging and FAQs by Friday COB.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: internal rollout target next Wed; external pilot invites the week after. product/eng confirm onboarding checklist green by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: staging canary yesterday revealed a memory leak in the continuous-batching path. rollback performed; no prod customer impact. SRE + Eng to run postmortem and mitigation plan.
Sam (CEO): Metrics: p50 latency improved ~10% WoW; p95 increased ~7% due to a long-tail regression. cost/token down ~2%. keep focus on p95 reduction.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft the customer-facing retention note and an FAQ. Hana, can you review legal phrasing?
Priya - VP Product: for Private GA I will open a readiness board. Diego — can you confirm telemetry toggle + KMS checks by Mon?
Diego - Eng Lead: got it. PRs out: #4998 telemetry-flag, #5001 batching-hotfix. Hotfix includes unit tests. Planning staging redeploy tomorrow AM.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief: staging OOM at 01:47 UTC from unbounded batch accumulation with very long prefixes (>8k tokens). Rolled back to tag v1.23.9 at 02:05 UTC. No prod impact. Postmortem Thu 15:00 UTC in #incidents. Runbook updated: https://internal.runbooks/retry-batching-oom
Alex - Head of Sales: several pilots asked about early access to Private GA. If invites go next week, we need a short outreach paragraph + FAQ to share. Priya/Hana can we get that by Mon noon?
Hana (Legal): suggested phrasing: "Default retention: 90 days; extended retention available via contractual terms." Will post redlines Thu AM and include DPA link.
deploy-bot: rollback executed: v1.24.0 -> v1.23.9 by Morgan (SRE) at 02:05 UTC. Logs: "ROLLBACK: MEM_PRESSURE_DETECTED"
Diego - Eng Lead: propose extending canary window from 30m -> 2h for batch-sensitive releases and adding kv-cache healthchecks. Will update rollout template.
Sam (CEO): agree. Diego & Morgan coordinate extended canary and add note to rollout checklist.
Sam (CEO): org asks: A) surface any blockers for Private GA invites by Mon 09:00 PT; B) if you are on the postmortem attendee list and cannot join, add notes to the doc beforehand.
Priya - VP Product: will own GA readiness board and ping owners Mon 09:15 PT.
Alex - Head of Sales: will draft outreach paragraph and share Mon noon.
Hana (Legal): will post redlines Thu AM and loop in compliance for DPA verification.
Morgan (SRE): postmortem doc + dial-in in #incidents; requesting Diego, infra, and one on-call dev to join.
Sam (CEO): thanks team. small, focused week — keep updates in this thread or DM urgent items. :thumbsup:
__comments: Slack thread stored as one continuous message string; messages chronological; no title per agents.md.
